subject: Geopolitics
title: Satellite Surveillance
description: A fast breakdown of Satellite Surveillance for builders.

hook.text: US spy satellites can read a license plate from orbit. The sky is full of cameras, and they never blink.

buildup.text: IMINT — imagery intelligence — uses satellites and drones to photograph military sites, troop movements, and more.

discovery.text: During the Cold War, satellites replaced risky U-2 spy flights. They could photograph the entire Soviet Union safely.

twist.text: Commercial satellites now rival government ones.

climax.text: Hiding military buildups is nearly impossible now. Ukraine war movements were tracked openly by satellite watchers.

punchline.text: Every secret base is only secret until a satellite passes.

quiz.question: How have commercial satellites changed intelligence?
options: They replaced all government spy satellites
They made military concealment nearly impossible for anyone
They are used only for weather monitoring
